waves.name: Reader side of the master file
waves.rationale: PGMR and READJOB read SPARQ.TEST.MASTER and write nothing another entry point uses, so this is the batch-readonly family and a sound first wave: the port is one OPEN, one READ, one CLOSE, and the legacy writer keeps feeding it during coexistence. The weakness is that PGMR produces no output. Its testable boundary is the dataset it reads and its return code, and the business value is close to nil, so this wave is mainly a toolchain and harness proof.
waves.unblocks: The LAYOUTX copybook conversion (wave 2 includes it too) and a harness that can decode SPARQ.TEST.MASTER on the target platform, including the packed decimal field, before the writer is touched.

waves.name: Writer of the master file
waves.rationale: PGMW and WRITEJOB write the one dataset another entry point reads, so this is the batch-writers family and it belongs after the reader: the consumer is proven against the legacy format first, then the producer is replaced and its bytes compared. It cannot be cut earlier because it is the only writer and READJOB has no other source. Do not read this as low risk: the port is easy and the verification is the work.
waves.unblocks: Retirement of the legacy writer and, if the dataset is later replaced by a table or a service, the one place where that change can be made.
